title_en: The Status of the Intellectually and Doctrinally Oppressed Person Regarding Hereafter Punishment (Part 1)
description_en: حکم المستضعف فکریأ و عقائديأ من حيث العقوبة الأخروية ق 1
summary: His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari discusses the status of the intellectually and doctrinally oppressed person regarding the punishment of the Hereafter.
